description: Sample JSON messages broadcast by FEL OS backend over WebSocket /ws/match/{match_id} and returnable via GET /api/debug/match/{match_id}/payload

match_state.description: Sent immediately on WS connect with the current match state.

match_start.description: Broadcast to all connected clients when a second player joins and match becomes 'active'. Includes Creator Card loadouts for each player so Nexus can apply stat modifiers.

score_dunk.description: POST /api/matches/{match_id}/score_dunk — compute server-authoritative dunk score using the match's seeded judge_offsets. Returns j1/j2/j3 panel scores, total, message, and is_perfect flag.

dunk_result.description: Broadcast to WS clients and persisted as an event when score_dunk is called.

export_replay.description: GET /api/matches/{match_id}/export-replay — full match replay including metadata, seed, judge_offsets, all events (match_start, score_events, dunk_results, match_end).
events: <array of all persisted events in chronological order>

score_event.description: Emitted when a player scores. seq is a monotonic counter for ordering/reconciliation. Nexus should update its scoreboard on every score_event.

match_end.description: Broadcast when all score_events have been emitted and the match is finished.

nexus_integration_notes.polling_mode: GET /api/debug/match/{match_id}/payload returns the same data as WS in a single HTTP call. Use this if Nexus WebSocket support is not yet wired.
nexus_integration_notes.system_scan_probe: GET /api/debug/latest-system-scan returns the last /api/system-scan/unified response cached in memory. Nexus can poll this to seed player PRQ/stats before match start.
nexus_integration_notes.creator_card_loadout: loadout[] in match_start is the simplified card summary. Full card data is available via GET /api/user-cards?user_id=... for Nexus to apply modifiers.
nexus_integration_notes.sequencing: Use seq field on score_event for ordering. Nexus should track highest seq seen and ignore events with lower seq to avoid double-counting.
nexus_integration_notes.mock_db_mode: Start backend with MOCK_DB=1 to use in-memory store — no MongoDB required for local Nexus dev.
nexus_integration_notes.seed_and_judge_offsets: Every match is created with a server-generated 64-bit seed. derive_judge_offsets(seed) deterministically produces 3 judge offsets in [-5,+5]. Both seed and judge_offsets are included in match_start and GET /api/matches/{match_id} so clients can reproduce scoring locally.
nexus_integration_notes.server_dunk_scoring: POST /api/matches/{match_id}/score_dunk is server-authoritative. Nexus submits approach_quality, execution_quality, style_difficulty (all 0.0-1.0). The server applies the match's seeded judge_offsets and returns j1/j2/j3/total/message/is_perfect. The result is persisted as a dunk_result event and broadcast over WS.
nexus_integration_notes.replay_export: GET /api/matches/{match_id}/export-replay returns the complete match record including all persisted events (match_start, score_events, dunk_results, match_end). Use for replay playback, audit, or QA verification.

curl_qa_commands.get_match: curl -s $API_BASE/api/matches/<MATCH_ID> | jq '{status:.status, players:.players, score:.score, seed:.seed, judge_offsets:.judge_offsets}'
